description: Charts v2 (pdfnative 1.7 via add_chart): a stacked bar chart with per-point data labels. Stacked kinds (stackedBar / stackedBarH) and area charts accumulate series; the engine validates cross-field rules (e.g. no log scale on stacked charts) and reports them as CHART_ERROR. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.
